intelligence.human_view: Think of it like a recipe handed down in the family. If someone says "make it exactly like this," and you make something close — a little less salt, a different pan, your own twist — you have not made the family dish. You have made your own dish, and it will not taste like theirs. Shawn has handed us the recipe a hundred times: Personal IS the Hub. Not like the Hub. Not part of the Hub. The Hub, with three labels changed. The same is true of About and Skills: the beautiful unfold and the slideshow already exist, in the agreement and the pricing page — take that exact code and put it there, and the look rides along with the mechanism. And the whole system organizes itself the same way a good kitchen does: everything has its shelf, everything is labelled, and you find what you need with one reach, not a dig through the whole cupboard. Colours are the same promise: magenta must look magenta, purple must look purple, and the two must read as clearly different at a glance, or the map is wrong. Links, too, must land where they say — a link that opens the wrong room is the wrong link, however good the page behind it is.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you have a beautiful toy castle! Your friend says, "Make me one just like it!" You do NOT build a castle that looks almost the same. You take the REAL castle and put it right there! Same towers, same doors, same everything — only the flag on top is yours! That is how we build pages now! And every colour must look like itself: purple looks purple, and pink looks pink! Your friends get sorted into neat groups, like toys into boxes! And every link takes you to the right room, never the wrong door!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — if someone asks you to copy a recipe exactly, dear, you don't make something close and call it done, you follow it to the letter! Personal is the Hub, love — the very same page, only the three little labels changed at the top! And About and Skills take the beautiful way the agreement opens, dear — the same unfolding, the same slideshow, not a copy that looks plain! Everything has its place, love — your friends sorted into neat groups, your colours true and easy to tell apart, and every link taking you to the right room, never the wrong door!
intelligence.naya_view: Personal IS the Hub, literally copied: take the Hub's code, stick it in the Personal space, relabel only the three pills to Personal / Business / World. The only difference is the top: feature cover + menus + search + standard menu bar; everything below mirrors the Hub exactly. About and Skills take the exact presentation code — agreement unfold, pricing slideshow — then optimize for the person and their skills; content filled in as him, in his voice, no placeholders. About's row: About / Photos / Videos / Socials; scroll unfolds, slideshow slideshows; Videos link-only, NO uploads. Auto-organization is universal: everything categorized, findable by search or one category click, never a dig — contacts get the same shelves as the feeds. Magenta must read magenta, Invite stays proper purple, prominent contrast at a glance. Socials is icons with honest stats — clicks ours, platform notifications only if sent — and the three cover buttons are re-mappable in Settings, defaults unchanged. Always send ALL the links as one set, edit while he reviews, re-send the whole edited set. Multi-view staged links carry the view hash, verified by opening.
